title: Server Components and the client boundary

videos.script:
So far, all of React has run in the browser. Today part of it moves to a server.

{{project}} First a second project, with Next.js, the framework most React projects use to run components on a server. Pinned, like the first.

{{async}} Then a component that is an async function. It fetches the planner from the API on the server, and the browser never asks for the data at all, because the data arrives inside the page.

{{gets}} Then what the browser actually gets: HTML with the numbers in it, and none of the component's code.

{{boundary}} Then a click, which a Server Component cannot answer. The error says why, and use client draws the line: the arrow keys become a small Client Component, and only it travels to the browser.

{{props}} Then what may cross that line. Strings do. Functions do not.

{{stream}} And last, the production build, a search through the files a browser receives, and a page whose first byte arrives at once and whose data arrives two seconds later, in the same response.
